description: Living state for all TOURney platform axes. One entry per axis. Updated by every tourney-* skill. Agents read this for context (50 tokens) instead of parsing HTML artifacts.

architecture.summary: Clean init layer, tournament_admins canonical, 11 versioned migrations. Settings store un-typed.

feature-depth.summary: 3 structures, 12 scoring formats, realtime, HIO. No score admin-edit UI, no tournament series.

ux.summary: Post-sprint review B+. 1 real open item: manifest.json missing apple-touch-icon 180px (requires PNG asset from Rob). 3 flagged bugs were false positives — code already handles them.

security.summary: 2 XSS closed (feed.html:375, admin.html:2185/2340). player_accounts RLS confirmed clean. Open: CSP unsafe-inline, SEND_INSTALL_EMAIL_SECRET (Rob manual), invitations/push_subscriptions permissive read.

business.summary: ToS + Privacy pages live at /tos /privacy. Footer links added. LLC still not formed — Stripe test-mode only, reg_open=false. Revenue path blocked by Rob manual action.

deployment.summary: GH Actions CI live: ESLint + Deno type-check on PRs. deploy-functions.yml ready (needs SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN + SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF repo secrets). No staging environment.

performance.summary: SW cache-first, realtime scorecard, DB indexes. No loading skeletons, no perf monitoring.

data-model.summary: 11 migrations clean. player_accounts RLS confirmed secure (authenticated-only, email=auth.email()). Remaining gap: settings store un-typed.

marketing.summary: Premium brand, clear pricing, live demo. No OG tags, no social proof, PWA differentiator buried.

onboarding.summary: Invite gate kills cold traffic. Signup requires pre-existing RSVP. PWA install orphaned.

finance.summary: 8-phase plan: LLC formation unblocks Stripe live mode, ToS, accounting, and tax posture. 3 P0 blockers all require Rob manual action.
